title: Bring up Linux UVC capture and save reproducible input frames
acceptance: Plan window Nov–Jan; document camera format, resolution, capture command and prerecorded fallback. Verified 640 × 480 MJPEG capture over Linux V4L2 on the DE1-SoC. Saved a source JPEG from a live hybrid prediction and replayed it through the CPU runner. Capture and replay commands are in the accelerator README.
